finalText:
**Redis, the cache, died. The app died with it.**

```
02:14:07  Redis refuses connections at 10.0.0.12:6379
  → reads fall straight through to the store
  → timeouts start, queue grows 52 → 568 (cap 500)
  → 02:31:44 worker-2 runs out of memory
  → 02:31:52 api killed, service down
```

All times 4 July 2026, UTC. It took 17 minutes.
All 13 reconnect tries were refused. Nothing healed itself.
